cohort: The study included 9,586 pregnancies, analyzing trimester-specific plasma cell-free RNA profiles from 42 early-onset preeclampsia, 43 late-onset preeclampsia cases, and 131 normotensive controls.
finding: Predictive models based on cfRNA signatures identified early-onset preeclampsia up to 18.0 weeks before clinical onset and late-onset preeclampsia up to 14.9 weeks in advance, offering a path to early, non-invasive, subtype-specific preeclampsia risk stratification.
